It reports that the correlation between MCSD scores and CAQ scores was not significant, suggesting the CAQ's resistance to self-enhancing bias. A weak but positive correlation was found between IQ scores and CAQ scores, indicating that the CAQ measures something distinct from IQ, thus supporting its discriminant validity.
